data.long_meaning: The name Wald is derived from the Old German word 'waldaz' meaning 'rule' or 'power'. In Middle English, it was used as a surname for someone who lived in or near a forest. In the context of Christianity, the name Wald can be seen as a reminder of God's protection and rule over our lives. The name Wald carries the meaning “Rule, Power, Protection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Wald usually hope their child will grow to embody rule, power, protection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
